content:
[L] high | bottom half of window | entire lower ~55% of the screen is solid black dead space, content rendered only in top strip
[C] high | full window | application content occupies only ~470px of an ~880px window, composition catastrophically unbalanced
[L] high | Pending approvals card, bottom edge | card border is clipped/truncated mid-element at the black region boundary, cut off mid-card
[S] high | Pending approvals card position | card floats alone at far left of a vast empty gray zone, no alignment with Rules table or grid above
[S] med | New Rule button vs header text | button sits at extreme top-right with inconsistent inset, crammed against window edge compared to generous header padding
[H] med | Rules table | headers NAME/WHEN/THEN are small, faint ALL-CAPS labels with weak contrast against column value emphasis, weak hierarchy
[H] med | rule rows | warning metadata ("legacy trigger — never fires", "needs approval") mixed inline with action values at equal weight, primary content not separated
[S] med | row action buttons | "enabled"/Edit/Delete buttons sit at inconsistent horizontal position with large dead gap after THEN column content
[C] med | THEN column | large empty stretch between "add tag 'stale'" text and the controls cluster, columns crushed against left while right side is whitespace
[S] low | New Rule button | "+ New Rule" black pill stylistically inconsistent with white Edit / red Delete button vocabulary elsewhere
[H] low | Pending approvals | "raw proposed action" disclosure label exposes debug-style terminology in the product UI
[S] low | Approve/Reject buttons | button pair uses different heights and corner radii, Reject visually heavier and misaligned baseline vs Approve
[C] low | rules count "2 rules" | sub-label sits directly under heading with cramped spacing and no visual pairing

VERDICT: unprofessional — a half-black window with a floating orphan card and debug vocabulary reads as a broken build, not a product.
